indications.trial_status: IMPACT Phase 2b 48-week topline reported Dec 19, 2025 (positive); End-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting Dec 2025; Phase 3 initiation planned 2026

indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; enrollment completed Nov 3, 2025; 24-week topline expected 2026
